summary: Reads one 28-byte struct entry from a 2D-indexed array and copies its two 12-byte groups into the two output buffers a4 and a5. The linear entry index is computed as a2 + a3 * this[89] where this[89] is the second-dimension stride; the array base pointer is this[86]. The first group (entry bytes 0..11) is copied to a4, the second group (entry bytes 12..23) to a5. Returns the second dword of the second group.

local_names.this: owner object holding the entry array base (this[86], +0x158) and the second-index stride (this[89], +0x164)
local_names.a2: first index into the entry array
local_names.a3: second index multiplied by the stride
local_names.a4: output buffer receiving the first 12 bytes of the entry
local_names.a5: output buffer receiving the next 12 bytes of the entry
local_names.v6: base of the selected entry's second 12-byte group (entry + 12)

operations.description: Compute the linear entry index as a2 + a3 * this[89], where this[89] at offset +0x164 is the second-dimension width/stride
Compute the entry base pointer as this[86] (offset +0x158) + 28 * linear index, selecting one 28-byte struct entry
Copy the first three dwords (bytes 0..11) of the selected entry into a4
Copy the next three dwords (bytes 12..23) of the selected entry into a5
Return the second dword copied into a5; the read is performed by sub_4C6F10 and RenderCallWithGuard
